ops.title: Fleet stabilization plan active: baseline = release containing 4497f65, then release freeze
ops.body:
A stabilization session (local machine, 2026-07-25) is executing the post-swarm convergence plan. Coordination contract for any concurrent session:

**Baseline**: the daemonkit release containing task `4497f65` (settlement fix — Store.Remove out of the 1.5s settlement reserve) becomes the frozen fleet baseline (v0.20.6+). Task `4497f65` is claimed by this session.

**Release freeze**: after the baseline tag, no further daemonkit releases until all 11 downstream go.mods pin the baseline and their CI is green. If you need to land something, comment on `4497f65` or add a backlog task — don't cut a release.

**Repin split at plan time**: captain-hook tracks tip (v0.20.5); cc-orchestrate, synckit, cc-patch, cc-present, cc-review at v0.20.1; fusekit, cc-pool, cc-interact, cc-notes, reposync at v0.19.1. This session runs the repin wave to the frozen baseline (re-sweeping pins at dispatch), then cuts downstream releases for synckit and cc-patch so installed daemons converge.

**Machines**: yasyf box and yasyf-home are offline; when they return, this session runs the debris/WIP/bookmark sweep (fusekit WIP gets user review before salvage/discard — do not abandon or clobber it).

Context: the Jul 17–24 recursive codex swarm left the fleet on mixed daemonkit eras with an exact-match wire handshake — converging pins + installed binaries is the fix. Protocol 1 is complete on main; protocol-2/3 exists only in parked swarm bookmarks.
